'''Sai'torr Kal Fas''' was [[Saurin]] [[Gender|female]] who was a skilled [[warrior]], serving as [[bodyguard]] for her cousin [[Hrchek Kal Fas]]. Hrchek wisely kept her close when the pair visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[1 BBY]]. While there, the two Saurins witnessed the [[bartender]] [[Wuher]] shout at the [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] about [[droid]]s that he had brought in with him, and later turned to watch when Skywalker got into a conflict with the two criminals [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]], which ended with the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] cutting down the criminals with his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ront_Byrnloo_at_the_cantina.png|thumb|right|300px|Sai'torr Kal Fas (left) and Hrchek Kal Fas (center) were patrons of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]]
Sai'torr Kal Fas was a [[Saurin]] [[Gender|female]] who served as [[bodyguard]] for her cousin [[Hrchek Kal Fas]].<ref name="Force Collection" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> the pair were both working as [[Merchant|traders]] and visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], where the locals knew the two Saurins as "Crockers."<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Hrchek wisely kept Sai'torr close while at the [[cantina]]<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> and the Saurin were stood a few places apart at the bar when the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered with the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]].<ref name="ANH" />

Sai'torr was speaking to a [[human]] at the bar with her back to Skywalker until<ref name="ANH" /> the [[Snivvian]] [[Zutton]]<ref name="AA">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> took the human's place. Sai'torr, Zutto,n and Hrchek all then turned to stare at Skywalker when the [[bartender]],<ref name="ANH" /> [[Wuher]],<ref name="CL" /> shout at the farmer that droids were not allowed inside the cantina. Sai'torr then turned back to talk to Zutton as Skywalker sent the droids outside. With the human having returned to the bar beside Sai'torr, her attention was once again drawn to Skywalker when he was confronted at the bar by the two criminals [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]]. After Kenobi tried to intervene, Evazan threw Skywalker to the floor, causing the [[Jedi]] to slash the two criminals with his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|lightsaber]].<ref name="ANH" /> 

Kenobi then looked challengingly around the room<ref name="ANH AD">{{Film|IV}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> and Sai'torr, Hrchek,<ref name="ANH" /> and the other patrons returned blithely to their drinks.<ref name="ANH AD" /> Sai'torr spoke to the human patron and<ref name="ANH" /> the [[Morseerian]] [[Nabrun Leids]]<ref name="AA" /> at the bar while Skywalker and Kenobi joined a table with the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]. The bodyguard remained in the conversation as [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s entered the cantina and passed by her, prompting Skywalker and Kenobi to leave. The two cousins were then stood together at the bar and watched as Solo tipped Wuher as he left, having shot the bounty hunter [[Greedo]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Sai'torr Kal Fas has [[Color|green]] skin and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="ANH" />

==Skills and abilities==
Sai'torr Kal Fas was a skilled [[warrior]].<ref name="Force Collection" />

==Equipment==
While in the cantina, Sai'torr wore a green [[Clothing|shirt]] under a tan sleeveless jacket.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|On my first days filming of the Cantina scenes, I remember sitting with Pam Rose, Leesub Sirln, wondering if I should introduce myself to the other Saurin, Barbara Frankland, but we were eventually placed together, and we spoke about the difficulties we had in breathing through the helmets. I explained that if you put a hand into the mouth, it would be better ventilation, which she did, and there are photos of her doing exactly that.|Laurie Goode|<ref name="Laurie Goode interview">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/episode-iv-a-new-hope/laurie-goode-saurin|text=Laurie Goode (Saurin)|author=[[Dennis Pellegrom]]|date=2010-05|work=[[Star Wars Interviews]]|archivedate=20230205201645|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
Sai'torr Kal Fas was portrayed by [[Barbara Frankland]]<ref name="Laurie Goode interview" /> in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The cantina scenes that she appears in were filmed between [[April 13]] and [[April 22]], [[1976]] on Stage 6 at [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> On set, Franklin and [[Laurie Goode]], who portrayed Hrchek Kal Fas, discussed how difficult it was to breathe in the Saurin masks, with Goode giving Franklin a tip about putting your hand into the mask's mouth to ventilate it better, which Franklin then did.<ref name="Laurie Goode interview" /> The Saurins initially wore green [[Wikipedia:Rubber glove|dish gloves]] with warts and scales on while on set, but when these peeled too much they were replaced with just normal dish gloves.<ref name="YouTube">{{YouTube|video=J7ygjomkfXQ|text=Star Wars: A New Hope - Cantina Archeology Part 1: Behind The Scenes of the Mos Eisley Cantina – UK|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref>

[[File:Mos_Eisley_BTS_group_shot.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Sai'torr Kal Fas mask was created by Stuart Freeborn.]]
Costume designer [[John Mollo]] drew a concept sketch of the Saurins, labeled as "Crocker"<ref name="MakingOf" /> with the name "Gila-Men" also applied to the pair.<ref name="Roll-Call">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> Sai'torr Kal Fas's mask and that of Hrchek Kal Fas were created by creature designer [[Stuart Freeborn]] and based on a [[Wikipedia:Crocodile|crocodile]], which earned the pair their "Crocker" nickname among the film crew. Hrcheck's was altered to be used for the character [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] in the [[1980]] sequel to ''A New Hope'', [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], while Sai'torr's remained unaltered and ended up in the private collection of ScienceFictionArchives.com.<ref name="Objets">''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]''</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Sai'torr Kal Fas was first identified in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="Force Collection" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref> The [[Sai'torr Kal Fas/Legends|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where she was first identified on a card in the [[1995]] [[Premiere Limited]] expansion set for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' produced by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Sai'torr Kal Fas}}</ref> There were plans for one of the two Saurin to be official named "Gilaass," but this name was never used.<ref name="Roll-Call" />
